care.summary: Tropical spice rhizome with broad leaves; needs heat, moisture, and a long frost-free season.
care.light: Partial sun to bright filtered light in hot climates
care.water: Keep consistently moist in growth; never waterlog pots without drainage
care.fertilizer: Monthly organic feed while leaves are lush
care.toxicity: Rhizome edible as spice; stain-prone when cut
common_issues: Rhizome rot in cool wet winters
Leaf scorch in harsh midday sun
Slow start if soil is cold
tips: Cut back after foliage dies down
care.climate_notes: Ideal outdoor plant for tropical/subtropical wet seasons; container culture elsewhere.
